theorems.name: Submission.idtp_ccd_scsp_local_inverse
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (p : Euclid P) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (F : Euclid P → Euclid 2), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 2 M → p ∈ M → IsOpen U → p ∈ U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 F U → (∀ v ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M p), fderiv ℝ F p v = 0 → v = 0) → ∃ (O : Set (Euclid 2)) (N : Set (Euclid P)) (G : Euclid 2 → Euclid P), IsOpen O ∧ IsOpen N ∧ F p ∈ O ∧ p ∈ N ∧ N ⊆ U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 G O ∧ G '' O = M ∩ N ∧ (∀ w ∈ O, F (G w) = w) ∧ ∀ w ∈ O, tangentSpace M (G w) = Set.range (fderiv ℝ G w)
